high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore feed, showcasing a sponsored post by the account "wallmantra." The post features a decorative wall piece that appears to be a backlit wooden wall art or night light. The artwork depicts seven horses in motion, with their silhouettes cut out of dark wood, illuminated from behind to create a glowing effect. The setting is a modern living room with a gray sofa adorned with two green throw pillows. The wall art is mounted above the sofa, adding a dynamic and artistic element to the space.
